messages:
Eli Ramos: quick sync — following yesterday's DR run we captured a few recurring patterns and some immediate action items. I want owners + ETA so we can close these before next game day.
Priya Shah: thanks. can we make a prioritized list? top issues from my notes: 1) delayed multi-region routing after control-plane flapping 2) missing snapshot cross-region verification 3) ambiguous restore runbook steps for DB shard resync
Marco Li: +1. also saw repeated token bucket exhaustion on north-virginia egress path — traffic shaping misconfig on the ingress path caused slow convergence.
Jenna Ortiz: assigning owners: Marco will take routing/traffic shaping, Priya will own snapshots/backup verification, Kayla take restore runbook updates. Eli will track rollups and comms.
Kayla Morris: noted. I'm going to split the runbook gaps into: pre-failover checks, execute restore, post-restore validation. ETA: draft updates by end of week, final by next Tue.
Eli Ramos: can you add explicit commands and expected outputs? we had confusion around the replica_lag check. please include exact queries and thresholds.
Kayla Morris: good call. will add a `CHECK_REPLICA` section with the SQL and acceptable ms thresholds.
SRE-Bot: reminder: @Marco Li, your on-call window starts in 2 days for the next game day.
Marco Li: ack. For routing: current policy falls back to regional DNS TTL of 60s, but the control-plane reconfig takes ~45-90s to push. I'm proposing a short-lived traffic-shaper that eases TTl swap — prototype config below:
```
# traffic-shaper (nginx) snippet
map $upstream_status $weight {
  ~5xx 10;
  default 100;
}
proxy_next_upstream_tries 3;
```
I'll run a small canary in eu-west first.
Priya Shah: backups: we found 6/36 snapshots missing cross-region copy tags. Root cause: S3 replication filter didn't include snapshots path. Action: add snapshots/ to replication config and run a scan script. I can own scan and repair. ETA: scan today, repair tomorrow.
Eli Ramos: add the scan script to repo and make it runnable as `./tools/snap-verify.sh --fix` so SRE can run during maintenance.
Priya Shah: will do. script will output a CSV of missing copies and a dry-run `--fix` plan.
Jenna Ortiz: for recurring incident pattern tracking: can we add one new metric to the ops dashboard — `failover_convergence_ms` tagged by region and route policy. That will help postmortem correlation. Owner: Jenna. ETA: next Thursday.
Marco Li: testing plan for routing change: run 3 simulated control-plane flaps with traffic load generator, measure convergence, compare to baseline. I'll post results in this thread.
Kayla Morris: runbook TODOs I'm capturing: 1) add CHECK_REPLICA SQL + expected outputs 2) include `snap-verify.sh` workflow 3) step-by-step DNS cutover with expected timings 4) fallback checklist with contact matrix (oncall + infra leads).
Eli Ramos: great. let's add deadlines into the follow-up tracker. I'm creating a jira epic and will link tickets here. ETA for epic: today EOD.
SRE-Bot: created JIRA EPIC RINF-2387: "DR: routing & backup remediation sprint" by Eli Ramos.
Eli Ramos: owners please update the corresponding ticket names when you start work. I'll run weekly status checks until all items are closed.
Priya Shah: started PR for replication config and upload tool: https://git.redwood/infra/snap-tools/pull/142 — please review.
Marco Li: can someone unblock env access for my canary? need a eu-west test pool. @Eli Ramos can you grant?
Eli Ramos: granted. Marco, you have access to `test-eu-west-standby` now.
Jenna Ortiz: added the dashboard metric draft to grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/DR/restore-metrics — feedback welcome.
Kayla Morris: draft runbook PR: https://git.redwood/playbooks/dr-restore/pull/57 — contains new validation steps and `CHECK_REPLICA` examples.
Eli Ramos: thanks team. Quick owners recap: Marco — routing & traffic shaping (canary + test), Priya — snapshot cross-region repair & tool, Kayla — runbook updates, Jenna — dashboard metric. Milestones: scan/repairs by +2 days, runbook final by +5 days, routing canary + results by +3 days. If any blocker, call me out ASAP. :thumbsup:
